correctness.rationale: The replacement RESULT.md reconciles a literal conflict in the frozen scope: removals are triggered by occupied-to-occupied attempts, not additional independent Poisson events. The clocks in the replacement agree with the original Finding, proof, and the configuration generator. On this precise model, balance gives (r+a_0)p_0=r and (r+a_j)p_j=a_(j-1)p_(j-1), including a_m=0; normalization telescopes. The unique reachable stationary class and site permutation symmetry give conditional uniformity. Factorial moments give the covariance; at small r the even case has N/2 contributing nonterminal levels while the odd case is a uniform singleton. At large r, one death produces a specified vacant pair with probability 2/r+O_N(r^-2), while two deaths and mean-product corrections are second order. The rational formula has a genuine sign-changing crossing for odd N; direct substitution gives the unique N=3 crossing at 2. This is an analytic check on the replacement for all fixed finite N and r>0, not an extrapolation of tests.
residual_risks: No uniqueness proof beyond N=3, no all-rate even-size sign classification, and no joint large-N scaling claim.

value.rationale: The exact count law by itself is a routine reset computation. Its application to labeled pair correlations exposes a sharp structural distinction: at rare refill an odd survivor excludes every other site, whereas at frequent refill a single annihilation creates vacancies in pairs and dominates the covariance. The result gives an all-size sign reversal and quantified opposite limits, rather than a finite-sample observation or novelty claim for the general mechanism.
residual_risks: Only complete graphs, fixed finite N and simultaneous full refills; not a spatial or general reset-reversal theorem.
